author: reek
body: The wake ceremony over a seed that lives in a raw buffer (B3.4). The ceremony itself is `codex/os/verify/WakeCeremony`, and its meaning is unchanged: verify the magic, recompute the content hash, check the author signature, and speak only what was checked -- or refuse.

author: reek
body: The signature is over the *stored* content hash, as `cdx-verify-signature` does. Recomputing the hash and comparing it to the stored one is the separate check; a machine that signed a hash of bytes it no longer carries must fail `hash-ok`, not quietly pass on a valid signature.

author: reek
body: A content end beyond the bytes actually read is a malformed header, not an invitation to hash memory we do not own.
